cohort: Eighty women who underwent post-placental IUCD insertion, with 40 subjects having had a Caesarean section and 40 having had a normal vaginal delivery.
finding: Post-placental IUCD insertion showed a higher continuation rate and lower complication rates (expulsion, bleeding, pain) in women who underwent Caesarean section compared to those who had a normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Outcomes for post-placental IUCD insertion, including expulsion, continuation, and complications like bleeding and pain, were found to be better in women who delivered via Caesarean section compared to those who had a normal vaginal delivery.
